title: Derivation of Angle of Repose on Rough Incline
assumptions: Rigid block resting on plane inclined at angle theta
starting_principles: Component equilibrium parallel and perpendicular to incline
Limiting friction condition f_s = mu_s N

ordered_steps.explanation: Set up equilibrium of forces perpendicular to the inclined plane.
Set up equilibrium of forces parallel to the inclined plane at critical angle theta_R.
Substitute limiting friction relation f_s,max = mu_s N and solve for tan(theta_R).

limiting_cases: For frictionless plane mu_s = 0, theta_R = 0 (block slips at any tilt)
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 6 p. 104; UP Ch 5 p. 190
